summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a 6-K announcing that Group CFO and Executive Director Pam Kaur will leave her role in 2027 and not stand for re-election at the 2027 AGM, with retirement no later than that meeting and a notice period ending 9 September 2027. The Board has begun a search for her successor, considering internal and external candidates; she moves to an advisory role to the Group CEO through end-2028. No deal terms, premium, or consideration apply. Watch governance risk, transition execution, and any succession announcement timing for management-stability signals.
